_about: Major requirements by year, transcribed from official Rutgers catalog and school pages (sources on each entry). sequence 'official': years follow the school's published curriculum; 'prerequisites': years follow course level (100-level in year 1, 200 in year 2, 300 in year 3, 400 in year 4), since the school publishes no year-by-year plan. Each entry names the catalog edition it was transcribed from and the date it was last checked against that catalog; lists follow the newest (2026–2027) catalogs, and students who entered earlier follow the catalog for their entry year.
